{{Quote|I recognize your face.''"<br />"''You should. I'm ''Arlain Zee''.|[[Volan Das/Legends|Volan Das]] and Arlain Zee|<ref name="Lockdown (comic)">{{TCWComicCite|6.47|Lockdown (comic story)}}</ref>}}
'''Arlain Zee''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who earned notoriety during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] after he swindled the individual [[Sli Genchu]] out of the proceeds of the [[Lodan job]], making him one of the most wanted men on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Zee was captured by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tempestuous]]'' alongside other wanted [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]], for transport to Coruscant. Zee and the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Volan Das/Legends|Volan Das]] were freed from their cells by Zee's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R5-Q3]], and the pair quickly incapacitated the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] guards [[Cale (clone trooper)|Cale]] and [[Reed (clone trooper)|Reed]] while R5-Q3 released several other bounty hunters. Zee and Das donned the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] of the fallen [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] and [[Riot aboard the Tempestuous|attempted]] to make their way to the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay along with the bounty hunters [[Esu]], [[Kessk]] and [[M-1991]]. Though the other bounty hunters were soon recaptured, Zee was able to escape the vessel by [[Mind uploading|downloading]] his consciousness into R5-Q3.
